rājāyatana.p: [Rāja+āyatana] (na) CL=7 [Devarājassa nivāsanaṭṭhānabhūtattā rājāyatanaṃ. Dhāna.ṭī.564. Rājādana-saṃ.] (1) The place where is living great Deva, Deva King, Shrine for Deva. (2) Shade tree bearing clusters of fragrant flowers Mimusops hexandra (or) Kind of fruit tree Sapium baccatum.
pn:
Rājāyatana. The name of a tree, at the foot of which the Buddha received a gift of wheat and honey from the merchants Tapassu and Bhallika in the eighth week after the Awakening (Vin.i.3f.; Ja.i.80; Bv-a.p.9.).

A Thūpa was later erected on the site of the tree. Beal-Xuan, op.cit., 129.
a: ဒေဝရာဇဿ နိဝါသနဋ္ဌာနဘူတတ္တာ ရာဇာယတနံ။ ဓာန်။ဋီ။၅၆၎။ ရာဇာဒန-သံ။] (၁)နတ်မင်းကြီးတို့၏ နေရာအရပ်၊ နတ်မင်း၊ နတ်ကွန်း၊ နတ်နန်း။(၂)လင်းလွန်းပင်။

B:
rājāyatana： rājāyatana（na）
ရာဇာယတန（န）
«rāja+āyatana．devarājassa nivāsanaṭṭhānabhūtattā rājāyatanaṃ．．ṭī．564．rājādana-saṃ．]
[ရာဇ+အာယတန။ ဒေဝရာဇဿ နိဝါသနဋ္ဌာနဘူတတ္တာ ရာဇာယတနံ။ ဓာန်။ဋီ။၅၆၄။ ရာဇာဒန-သံ။]
V:
Rājāyatana：The name of a tree，at the foot of which the Buddha received a gift of wheat and honey from the merchants Tapassu andBhallika in the eighth week after the Enlightenment （Vin．i．3f．； J．i．80； BuA．p．9．）．

A thūpa was later erected on the site of the tree．Beal，op．cit．，129．
K:

[ရာဇ+အာယတန။ ဒေဝရာဇဿ နိဝါသနဋ္ဌာနဘူတတ္တာ ရာဇာယတနံ။ ဓာန်။ဋီ။၅၆၄။ ရာဇာဒန-သံ။]
